memory_records_due.name: memory_records_due
memory_records_due.where: "memory_records"."status" in ('open', 'unconfirmed') and "memory_records"."superseded_at" is null and "memory_records"."deleted_at" is null

memory_records_remind.name: memory_records_remind
memory_records_remind.where: "memory_records"."remind_at" is not null and "memory_records"."reminded_at" is null

memory_records_precision.name: memory_records_precision
memory_records_precision.value:
("memory_records"."occurred_at" is null) = ("memory_records"."occurred_precision" is null)
          and ("memory_records"."occurred_precision" is null or "memory_records"."occurred_precision" in ('day', 'week', 'month', 'year'))

memory_records_status.name: memory_records_status
memory_records_status.value:
("memory_records"."kind" = 'commitment') = ("memory_records"."status" is not null)
          and ("memory_records"."status" is null or "memory_records"."status" in ('open', 'unconfirmed', 'done', 'cancelled'))

memory_records_rule.name: memory_records_rule
memory_records_rule.value:
("memory_records"."rule_kind" is null or ("memory_records"."kind" = 'rule' and (
            ("memory_records"."rule_kind" in ('rhythm', 'wait') and "memory_records"."interval_days" > 0)
            or ("memory_records"."rule_kind" = 'date' and "memory_records"."interval_days" is null and "memory_records"."repeat" in ('year', 'month', 'week') and "memory_records"."occurred_at" is not null))))
          and ("memory_records"."interval_days" is null or "memory_records"."kind" = 'rule')
          and ("memory_records"."repeat" is null or "memory_records"."rule_kind" = 'date'
            or ("memory_records"."kind" = 'commitment' and "memory_records"."remind_at" is not null
              and "memory_records"."repeat" in ('day', 'weekdays', 'week', 'month', 'year')))
